# Koka Sexton — GTM Skills (mini-Koka)

> A mini Koka you install into a code agent. A Claude Code / MCP skill system for GTM operators — content engineering, engagement intelligence, and signal-led outbound — grounded in the LinkedIn Algorithm Report (2,279 posts / 246 creators) and the Content Engineering Stack. API/MCP-native; the skills are free.

## Install

**Any MCP client** (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude Desktop) — one line:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "koka-gtm": { "command": "node",
    "args": ["/absolute/path/to/koka-sexton-gtm-skills/mcp/server.mjs"] } } }
```

Tools: `list_skills`, `get_skill`, `search_skills`, `get_persona`. Every `SKILL.md` is also a resource (`skill://<name>`).

**Claude Code, by files:** `cp -r koka-sexton-gtm-skills/skills/* ~/.claude/skills/`

## Skills

Orchestrators (route like Koka): `content-engineer`, `engagement-intelligence`, `signal-outbound`.
Sub-skills: `linkedin-algorithm`, `buying-signals`, `cold-email`, `gtm-plays`, `personalization`, and growing.

## Persona

`KOKA.md` is the operating character every skill inherits (signal over vanity, evidence over opinion, systems over hacks, fewer-better, comments-are-CRM). `KOKA-FIRST.md` is the defaults + escalation layer.
